description: This file defines a convention class for ASP.NET Core MVC that groups API endpoints by their route prefix, typically representing the API version. It implements IControllerModelConvention to modify the grouping for controllers based on route attributes.

classes.name: GroupByApiRootConvention
classes.description: A convention class implementing IControllerModelConvention to set API version groupings based on route templates.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Method that applies the convention to a given controller model, extracting the API version from the route attribute and setting the group name accordingly.
